fields.Address: 1187 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Tiger Woods' TGR Design built these real-turf putting courses complete with bunkers and challenging greens. Order food and cocktails delivered right to your group between holes at Broadway at the Beach.
fields.Name: PopStroke Myrtle Beach

fields.Address: 1220 Moser St, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Grab 3D glasses and putt through a spooky, glow-in-the-dark haunted course inside this air-conditioned entertainment spot at The Market Common. Bowling, billiards and a milkshake bar make it a solid rainy-day or date-night pick.
fields.Name: 810 Billiards & Bowling 3D Haunted Mini Golf

fields.Address: 2900 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Pick between the Ice Age and Predator courses and putt beneath towering dinosaurs. It's a roaring good time right on the main drag in south Myrtle Beach.
fields.Name: Jurassic Golf

fields.Address: 614 Sea Mountain Hwy, Unit A, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Set sail on a swashbuckling 18-hole pirate adventure just steps from Cherry Grove. Afterward, hit the arcade and cool off with a scoop from the on-site ice cream shop.
fields.Name: Black Pearl Mini Golf

fields.Address: 701 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Life-size dinosaurs lurk around every corner of these two 18-hole prehistoric courses. Little paleontologists will love spotting T. rex between putts.
fields.Name: Professor Hacker's Dinosaur Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 1010 Vereen Rd, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Play Pele's Revenge outdoors around a towering volcano, then head inside to the air-conditioned Lava Louie's Challenge. It's a smart pick for hot afternoons or rainy days.
fields.Name: Molten Mountain Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 2001 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Putt past a fierce red dragon and pagoda-style scenery inspired by Asian legends and pirate lore. It's a colorful change of pace from the usual tropical courses.
fields.Name: Red Dragon Cove Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 2101 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Climb a 50-foot Mayan pyramid and explore jungle ruins across 27 holes, with some played indoors. It's one of the most dramatic-looking courses in town.
fields.Name: Cancun Lagoon Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 3215 Hwy 17 Business, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: Follow cascading waterfalls and mysterious caves on an adventure voyage near the Marsh Walk. Treat yourself afterward at the Sweet Adventures ice cream shop.
fields.Name: Inlet Adventure Mini Golf

fields.Address: 1820 21st Ave N, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Pair a round on two 18-hole mini-golf courses with go-karts, kiddie rides and a big arcade at one of Myrtle Beach's best-known family fun parks. Great for groups who want to do a little of everything in one stop.
fields.Name: Broadway Grand Prix Challenge Mini Golf

fields.Address: 3009 Hwy 17 Business, Garden City, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: Play past Gilligan's hut, the Skipper's helm and Mary Ann's coconut grove on this tribute to the classic TV show. A snack bar and easy parking make it a stress-free family stop.
fields.Name: Gilligan's Island Funland

fields.Address: 1705 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Ride a mining train up the mountain to the first tee, then hunt for treasure past caves, waterfalls and volcanoes. Two 18-hole courses make it an easy spot to spend a whole evening.
fields.Name: Professor Hacker's Lost Treasure Golf

fields.Address: 915 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Three stories of glow-in-the-dark, neon-lit mini golf right on the Boardwalk. Fully air-conditioned, it's the perfect escape from summer heat or a rainy day.
fields.Name: Ripley's Crazy Golf

fields.Address: 2601 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Strike it rich on this gold-rush-themed putt-putt course just off the oceanfront near Anderson Ocean Club. It's an easy walk from many beachfront hotels when the kids need a break from the sand.
fields.Name: Lost Mine Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 1800 Hwy 17 Business, Murrells Inlet, SC 29576
fields.Short Description: Two Jamaica-inspired courses, Cockpit Country and Dunn's River Falls, feature caves, lighthouses and a big waterfall. Finish with hand-dipped Hershey's ice cream on site at Tupelo Bay.
fields.Name: Runaway Bay Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 3607 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Putt around an outdoor 18-hole mini-golf course with sloped greens at this beach-themed family spot that opened in September 2026. Afterward, head inside for duckpin bowling, a big arcade, a shark aquarium and a full seafood menu.
fields.Name: AlleyOops North Myrtle Beach

fields.Address: 1500 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A giant pirate ship anchored in the lagoon sets the stage for a classic buccaneer round. It's a great pick for crews looking for that iconic Myrtle Beach pirate experience.
fields.Name: Pirate's Watch Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 9850 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Short Description: Formerly Rainbow Falls, this north-end putt-putt spot now carries the Aloha island look across two 18-hole courses. It's a handy round if you're staying near the Restaurant Row end of Kings Highway.
fields.Name: Aloha Falls Mini Golf

fields.Address: 4205 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Two island-themed courses wind through tropical greenery with music playing across the complex. It's a laid-back, aloha-style round that's perfect for an easygoing evening.
fields.Name: Aloha Village Mini Golf

fields.Address: 901 Hwy 17 N, Little River, SC 29566
fields.Short Description: Two 18-hole putt-putt courses, Tiki Bay and Volcano Valley, wind past volcanoes, caverns, lakes and waterfalls at the Harbour View Golf Complex. It's the northernmost mini-golf stop on the Strand and an easy pick if you're staying in Little River or Cherry Grove.
fields.Name: Tribal Island Tiki Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 301 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Pirate ships sit anchored in the lagoons of this swashbuckling mini-golf course, with pirate audio piping in as you putt. A fun, classic round for little buccaneers right on Highway 17 in North Myrtle Beach.
fields.Name: Mutiny Bay Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 4827 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29575
fields.Short Description: Play a round of putt-putt, then sift for gems and arrowheads at the mining sluice, a two-for-one outing kids love. It sits on the south end of Kings Highway between Myrtle Beach and Surfside.
fields.Name: Snake River Golf and Gem Mining

fields.Address: 7101 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Short Description: Life-size elephants, giraffes and big cats line the fairways of this safari-themed course. Kids get a wildlife adventure with every hole.
fields.Name: Jungle Safari Mini Golf

fields.Address: 2205 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Sail into Neverland with animatronic pirates, cascading waterfalls and Captain Hook's famous ship. It's a fan favorite for families with young adventurers.
fields.Name: Captain Hook's Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 900 Lake Arrowhead Rd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Short Description: Choose from two lush outdoor courses or the indoor course upstairs, complete with tiki decor and talking tropical birds. An arcade and batting cages round out a full night of fun.
fields.Name: Aloha Mini Golf

fields.Address: 715 Hwy 17 N, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Putt your way past a crashed cargo plane and a rescue helicopter on two jungle-themed 18-hole courses. The over-the-top scenery makes it one of the most photographed courses on the Strand.
fields.Name: Mayday Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 3801 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A pirate-themed course with an arcade, snack bar and gift shop all in one stop. Summer nights bring lit-up golf for an after-dinner round.
fields.Name: Spy Glass Adventure Golf

fields.Address: 3210 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Short Description: Home of the U.S. Pro Mini Golf Association's Masters, this 36-hole course is built around a rumbling, fire-belching volcano. It's a true test for serious putters and a blast for the whole family.
fields.Name: Hawaiian Rumble Golf

fields.Address: 704 S Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Look for the giant roadside sea captain and the ship-shaped clubhouse at this old-school mini-golf landmark, formerly known as Cap'n Cain. It's an affordable, no-frills 18 holes that has been part of the Kings Highway scene for decades.
fields.Name: Captain Myrtle Mini Golf

fields.Address: 404 5th Ave S, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A classic tropical course tucked just off the oceanfront, shaded by palms and full of jungle charm. It's a convenient, easy stroll from many beachfront hotels.
fields.Name: Jungle Lagoon Miniature Golf

fields.Address: 707 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Explore the mythical lost city of Atlantis on a multi-level course with sweeping ocean views from the top. Its quirky storytelling and signage make it a cult favorite.
fields.Name: Mt. Atlanticus Minotaur Goff

fields.Address: 735 Hwy 17 S, Surfside Beach, SC 29575
fields.Short Description: One of the Strand's newest spots offers 36 tropical, surf-themed holes with tiki torches and seashell-studded obstacles. Head inside afterward for the arcade and a slice from the pizza pub.
fields.Name: Mulligan's Lagoon Golf and Arcade

fields.Address: 4801 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: A Myrtle Beach classic since 1981, this pirate course is all about old-school mini golf charm. Great for families who want a relaxed, nostalgic round.
fields.Name: Treasure Island Golf

fields.Address: 3301 S Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Short Description: Navigate the wreckage of a pirate ship on this ocean-side adventure course. Caves, bridges and waterfalls keep every hole interesting.
fields.Name: Shipwreck Island Adventure Golf
